note: Authored in Blender, consumed by the browser. Values are Principled BSDF sliders; Cycles is not three.js, so expect one round trip.

CAP_COPPER.note: Anchored 2026-08-31 to physicallybased-library metal F0. Library color arrays are ALREADY sRGB fractions (they match Filament's published sRGB F0) - map *255 directly, never re-encode (double-encoding washed the golds out). ACES desaturates clipped highlights - coloured metals run LOWER envMapIntensity than silver so their hue survives the tone curve.

CAP_WHITE.note: white phenolic - must READ white; components carry their own bright env in the lab because the dark glass room greys it. Jordan 2026-08-31: caps are PHENOLIC/COMPOSITE PLASTIC; gold/silver/copper are METALLIZED finishes on plastic, not solid metal. Finish matrix: black+white phenolic, copper MATTE only, silver shiny+matte, gold shiny+matte.

PART_ACTUATOR_PP.note: the sprayer ACTUATOR IS ALWAYS WHITE PP - only the collar carries the trim colour (PSD reference 13. 17-415 Spray, all six colourways, 2026-08-31).

PART_BALL_STEEL.note: metal.steel from the absorbed library (physicallybased.info, CC0): #e0dfdd - genuinely DARKER than silver, which is what gives a roller ball its dark flanks. Reflects the peak-capped universal studio: the uncapped version peaked at 3335x and any mirror blew to pure white (the 'transparent dome').

PART_HOUSING_PP_NATURAL.note: natural (undyed) PP: translucent milky, NOT white plastic. Jordan 2026-08-31 against the real roller housing.
